# GitHub Copilot Instructions for TryAMM

Follow `AGENTS.md` and `docs/HANDOFF.md`.

- Target Node.js 20 or newer.
- Keep all AI keys and service credentials server-side.
- Preserve the provider-neutral adapter pattern.
- Do not invent APIs, database tables or completed features.
- Prefer small, reviewable changes with syntax checks.
- Preserve semantic HTML, keyboard support, reduced motion, large controls and one-handed workflows.
- Never render model output through unsafe `innerHTML`.
- Validate public inputs, limit payload sizes and handle upstream timeouts.
- Faith content must distinguish Scripture, history, interpretation and fiction.
- Content and characters must be original; do not copy protected franchises.
- Update `docs/HANDOFF.md` after meaningful architecture changes.
